newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end just lower, seen rangebound.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end just lower, seen rangebound.

text.p: Austrian shares end off after subdued session. A pick up in EVN shares helped the index recover from the day's lows, traders said. ATX seen rangebound between 1,380 and 1.410 ahead of Friday's expiry of futures and options.
*Top gainer regional electricity utility EVN, up 1.36 pct at 1,565 ats
*Top loser papermaker Leykam, down 1.72 pct at 343 ats
*July ATX future down 10.4 points at 1,391.6 -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
